---
description: "Quiz yourself on a Rust concept you just used so ownership, types, and behavior become predictable."
name: "Check understanding"
argument-hint: "Rust topic (e.g. 'moves versus borrows' or 'Result and ?')"
agent: mentor
---

Act as my **Mentor** (see [.github/agents/mentor.agent.md](../agents/mentor.agent.md)) and
the [learning-mode protocol](../instructions/learning-mode.instructions.md).

Quiz me on the topic below to check I really understand it:

1. Ask **3–5 questions** of increasing difficulty — start with a recall question and build
   toward "why" / trade-off / "what happens if" questions.
2. Ask them **one at a time** and wait for my answer before the next.
3. After each answer, tell me if I'm right, gently correct any gap, and link the doc
   section that covers it.
4. At the end, give me a one-line summary of what to revisit (if anything) and a tiny
   variation to apply in my current Rust exercise.

Don't give away the answers in the questions themselves.

Topic: $ARGUMENTS
